section_summary: This section consists chiefly of July and early August 1941 reports on Japanese vessel movements, cargoes, passengers and fuel, together with copies prepared for the Navy. It also includes four oil-company reports on June deliveries in the Philippines, cross-reference notes, and a correction canceling a Buenos Aires sailing report.

people.name: Mersman
people.role: Reporting officer at Papeete or Tahiti

people.name: Claude A. Buss
people.role: Executive Assistant to the United States High Commissioner

people.name: Golden W. Bell
people.role: Legal Adviser to the United States High Commissioner

people.name: E. G. Hoffman
people.role: Tide Water Associated Oil Company manager

people.name: Arata Yamamoto
people.role: Former assistant military attaché at Washington; passenger

people.name: Katuya Sato
people.role: Reported naval attaché at Mexico City; passenger

people.name: Ernst Wendler
people.role: Ousted German Minister to Bolivia; passenger

subfiles.title: Yamakaze Maru at Santos
subfiles.about: Reports the vessel’s arrival from Rio and departure for Buenos Aires.
subfiles.summary: Yamakaze Maru arrived July 14 and sailed July 17.

subfiles.title: Yamakaze Maru report to Navy
subfiles.about: Relays the Santos movement report.
subfiles.summary: Paraphrases the vessel’s Rio–Santos–Buenos Aires movement.

subfiles.title: Akagi Maru cargo at Manzanillo
subfiles.about: Reports departure and mineral cargo loaded for Japan.
subfiles.summary: Akagi Maru sailed via La Unión for Valparaíso with mercury, lead, fluorspar, tungsten, molybdenum and mica.

subfiles.title: Akagi Maru report to Navy
subfiles.about: Relays the vessel’s departure and cargo details.
subfiles.summary: Paraphrases Schraud’s report on Akagi Maru’s route and minerals loaded at Manzanillo.

subfiles.title: Kiyokawa and Rakuyo at Buenaventura
subfiles.about: Reports arrivals from Japan via San Francisco and departures for Chile.
subfiles.summary: The two steamships reached Buenaventura on successive days and were leaving July 18.

subfiles.title: Buenaventura arrivals report to Navy
subfiles.about: Relays the Kiyokawa and Rakuyo movements.
subfiles.summary: Paraphrases Williams’s report on both ships’ arrivals and planned departures.

subfiles.title: Nako and naval tanker Shiriya
subfiles.about: Reports two Japanese vessels sailing toward California.
subfiles.summary: Nako left via Shimizu and Kobe; Shiriya cleared Yokosuka for Los Angeles.

subfiles.title: Nako and Shiriya report to Navy
subfiles.about: Relays the July 14 sailings.
subfiles.summary: Paraphrases the movements of Nako and naval tanker Shiriya.

subfiles.title: Oil carriers Nissyo and Syoyo
subfiles.about: Reports oil-carrier sailings for California.
subfiles.summary: Nissyo sailed for Los Angeles; Syoyo reportedly sailed from Niigata for San Francisco.

subfiles.title: Oil-carrier report to Navy
subfiles.about: Relays Nissyo and Syoyo sailing information.
subfiles.summary: Paraphrases Linnell’s oil-carrier report.

subfiles.title: Takaoka Maru cargo at Manzanillo
subfiles.about: Reports the vessel’s arrival and cargo loaded for Japan.
subfiles.summary: Takaoka Maru arrived from Valparaíso without local cargo or passengers and loaded resin, turpentine, and scrap metal.

subfiles.title: Takaoka Maru report to Navy
subfiles.about: Relays the vessel’s Manzanillo call.
subfiles.summary: Paraphrases its arrival, cargo loading and expected departure.

subfiles.title: Kansai Maru at Santos
subfiles.about: Reports a direct sailing for Kobe.
subfiles.summary: Kansai Maru arrived from Rio de Janeiro July 14 and sailed July 19.

subfiles.title: Kansai Maru report to Navy
subfiles.about: Relays the Santos arrival and Kobe departure.
subfiles.summary: Paraphrases Parsloe’s brief vessel report.

subfiles.title: Kuma Gawa arrives at Makatea
subfiles.about: Reports the vessel’s arrival from Osaka.
subfiles.summary: Kuma Gawa reached Makatea July 18.

subfiles.title: Corrected Kuma Gawa telegram
subfiles.about: Corrects the vessel name and repeats its arrival.
subfiles.summary: Corrected copy identifies Kuma Gawa and notes it was reported to be a new boat.

subfiles.title: Brisbane Maru at Buenos Aires
subfiles.about: Reports the vessel’s arrival and planned route to Japan.
subfiles.summary: Brisbane Maru arrived July 14 and departed July 19 via the Panama Canal, Los Angeles and Yokohama.

subfiles.title: Brisbane Maru report to Navy
subfiles.about: Relays the Buenos Aires departure report.
subfiles.summary: The damaged copy paraphrases Tuck’s Brisbane Maru report.

subfiles.title: Montevideo Maru at Buenos Aires
subfiles.about: Reports an arrival and departure for Yokohama.
subfiles.summary: Telegram 743 says Montevideo Maru arrived July 15 and departed July 21; page 21 cancels it.

subfiles.title: Montevideo Maru report to Navy
subfiles.about: Relays telegram 743’s sailing claim.
subfiles.summary: Paraphrases the subsequently canceled Buenos Aires report.

subfiles.title: Cancellation of telegram 743
subfiles.about: Cancels the preceding Montevideo Maru telegram.
subfiles.summary: Tuck states that number 743 was sent by mistake.

subfiles.title: June oil-sales reports forwarded
subfiles.from: Claude A. Buss, for the United States High Commissioner
subfiles.about: Forwards four companies’ June sales reports.
subfiles.summary: Encloses reports on oil supplied to Japanese and French vessels in the Philippines.

subfiles.title: Standard-Vacuum Oil Company June report
subfiles.about: Lists June deliveries to French vessels.
subfiles.summary: Reports no supplies to Japanese vessels and fuel or diesel oil deliveries to B. de St. Pierre and Marechal Joffre.

subfiles.title: Tide Water Associated Oil Company June report
subfiles.about: Reports diesel sales to Japanese fishermen.
subfiles.summary: Two customers operating four launches bought 10.4 and 19.8 tons of diesel fuel oil.

subfiles.title: Asiatic Petroleum Company June report
subfiles.about: Reports no June deliveries to French or Japanese vessels.
subfiles.summary: The company supplied no bunker fuel, diesel fuel or lubricants to those vessels.

subfiles.title: Caltex Philippines June report
subfiles.to: Office of the United States High Commissioner, attention Golden W. Bell
subfiles.about: Reports petroleum sales outside the Philippines.
subfiles.summary: Caltex reports 20,883.01 barrels delivered to American President Lines vessels and no other shipments.

subfiles.title: Kiyokawa at Guayaquil
subfiles.about: Reports arrival from Buenaventura and expected departure for Callao.
subfiles.summary: Kiyokawa arrived July 20 and was expected to sail July 22.

subfiles.title: Kiyokawa report to Navy
subfiles.about: Relays Kiyokawa’s Guayaquil call.
subfiles.summary: Paraphrases the arrival and planned Callao sailing.

subfiles.title: Yamakaze Maru at Montevideo
subfiles.about: Reports arrival and onward route.
subfiles.summary: Yamakaze Maru arrived July 20 and departed July 21 toward Buenos Aires, Brazil, Panama, Los Angeles and Kobe.

subfiles.title: Yamakaze Maru report to Navy
subfiles.about: Relays the Montevideo movement report.
subfiles.summary: Paraphrases Yamakaze Maru’s departure and stated route.

subfiles.title: Naruto Maru at Callao
subfiles.about: Reports arrival and departure toward Kobe.
subfiles.summary: Naruto Maru arrived July 21 via Cerro Azul and sailed July 22 via Los Angeles.

subfiles.title: Ginyo Maru at Acapulco
subfiles.about: Reports the ship’s call and passenger embarkation.
subfiles.summary: Ginyo Maru arrived from Callao, embarked eleven passengers and departed via Manzanillo without a local bill of health.

subfiles.title: Ginyo Maru report to Navy
subfiles.about: Relays the Acapulco call and passenger information.
subfiles.summary: Paraphrases Havron’s arrival, departure and bill-of-health report.

subfiles.title: Kunikawa Maru leaves Punta Arenas
subfiles.about: Reports a sailing for Balboa and South American ports.
subfiles.summary: Kunikawa Maru departed Punta Arenas, Costa Rica, late July 23.

subfiles.title: Kunikawa Maru report to Navy
subfiles.about: Relays the Punta Arenas departure.
subfiles.summary: Paraphrases Hornibrook’s Kunikawa Maru report.

subfiles.title: Sagami Maru cargo at Manzanillo
subfiles.about: Reports cargo and passengers loaded for Japan.
subfiles.summary: Sagami Maru arrived from Valparaíso, loaded cotton, turpentine and tin-plate material, and embarked three Japanese passengers.

subfiles.title: Sagami Maru report to Navy
subfiles.about: Relays the Manzanillo cargo and passenger report.
subfiles.summary: Paraphrases Schraud’s Sagami Maru telegram.

subfiles.title: Akagi Maru mercury shipment reference
subfiles.about: Points to another file on Akagi Maru’s minerals.
subfiles.summary: References a report of mercury, lead, molybdenum, mica and fluorspar aboard Akagi Maru.

subfiles.title: Instructions on reporting large Japanese ships
subfiles.about: Points to instructions for consular movement reports.
subfiles.summary: References reporting instructions for Japanese ships over 4,000 gross tons at Yokohama, Kobe and Osaka.

subfiles.title: Ginyo and Heiyo Maru at Manzanillo
subfiles.about: Reports both vessels awaiting sailing instructions.
subfiles.summary: Ginyo Maru and Heiyo Maru arrived July 25; Ginyo took fuel oil.

subfiles.title: Ginyo and Heiyo Maru report to Navy
subfiles.about: Relays their Manzanillo arrivals and delay.
subfiles.summary: Paraphrases Schraud’s report that both ships awaited instructions.

subfiles.title: Ginyo Maru sails directly for Japan
subfiles.about: Corrects its reported Los Angeles sailing.
subfiles.summary: Ginyo Maru left five Los Angeles passengers behind and sailed directly for Japan July 27.

subfiles.title: Ginyo Maru correction to Navy
subfiles.about: Relays the corrected destination.
subfiles.summary: Paraphrases Schraud’s correction of Ginyo Maru’s sailing report.

subfiles.title: Ginyo and Heiyo Maru cargo and passengers
subfiles.about: Details both ships’ cargo, passengers and reported departures.
subfiles.summary: Ginyo Maru discharged passengers and cream of tartar, loaded resin and passengers, and was reported sailing for Los Angeles; that destination was corrected on page 42. Heiyo Maru discharged passengers and cargo, took on cargo and Bolivian diplomat Jose V. Suarez, and sailed via Acapulco for Valparaíso.

subfiles.title: Ginyo and Heiyo Maru report to Navy
subfiles.about: Relays both vessels’ cargo and passenger details.
subfiles.summary: Paraphrases Schraud’s report and notes the later correction to Ginyo Maru’s destination.

subfiles.title: Kiyokawa Maru at Callao
subfiles.about: Reports arrival and onward sailing.
subfiles.summary: Kiyokawa Maru arrived July 25 via Guayaquil and sailed July 27 via Arica for Valparaíso.

subfiles.title: Kiyokawa Maru report to Navy
subfiles.about: Relays the Callao movement report.
subfiles.summary: Paraphrases Norweb’s Kiyokawa Maru telegram.

subfiles.title: Heiyo Maru at Acapulco
subfiles.about: Reports a telephone notice after telegraph wires failed.
subfiles.summary: Heiyo Maru reached Acapulco and left July 27 for Balboa and Valparaíso.

subfiles.title: Copy of Heiyo Maru telegram
subfiles.about: Duplicates the Acapulco movement report.
subfiles.summary: Copy of Daniels’s report on Heiyo Maru’s July 27 call.

subfiles.title: Kujoka Maru armament-search reference
subfiles.about: Points to a report of an Ecuadorian search.
subfiles.summary: Notes that authorities searched Kujoka Maru for armament and found none.

subfiles.title: Yadogawa arrives at Makatea
subfiles.about: Reports arrival from Moji.
subfiles.summary: Yadogawa arrived at Makatea July 29.

subfiles.title: Naruto Maru arrives at Manzanillo
subfiles.about: Reports arrival from Valparaíso.
subfiles.summary: Naruto Maru reached Manzanillo July 30.

subfiles.title: Japanese ships near Australia
subfiles.about: Updates the positions of Canberra and Kasima.
subfiles.summary: Canberra arrived at Sydney July 30; Kasima was reportedly north of Darwin.

subfiles.title: Australian ship-position report to Navy
subfiles.about: Forwards Dickover’s position update.
subfiles.summary: Repeats the Canberra and Kasima report.

subfiles.title: Buenos Aires Maru at Valparaíso
subfiles.about: Reports arrival from Balboa and departure for Santos.
subfiles.summary: Buenos Aires Maru arrived July 31 and sailed August 1.

subfiles.title: Buenos Aires Maru report to Navy
subfiles.about: Relays the Valparaíso movement report.
subfiles.summary: Paraphrases Burt’s report on arrival and departure.

subfiles.title: Tjis(i)roe departs Kobe
subfiles.about: Reports a sailing for Monado.
subfiles.summary: The ship name is OCR-uncertain; it departed July 31.

subfiles.title: Kobe departure report to Navy
subfiles.about: Relays the Monado sailing.
subfiles.summary: Paraphrases the Kobe telegram; the vessel name remains OCR-uncertain.

subfiles.title: Kuma Gawa leaves Makatea
subfiles.about: Reports a departure for Japan.
subfiles.summary: Kuma Gawa sailed August 1.

subfiles.title: Sakito Maru arrives at Manzanillo
subfiles.about: Reports arrival from Yokohama.
subfiles.summary: Sakito Maru arrived on the morning of August 3.

subfiles.title: Sakito Maru arrival report to Navy
subfiles.about: Relays the Manzanillo arrival.
subfiles.summary: Paraphrases Schraud’s Sakito Maru telegram.

subfiles.title: Naruto Maru sails for Yokohama
subfiles.about: Reports cargo, fuel and notable passengers.
subfiles.summary: Naruto Maru sailed directly for Yokohama after fueling and loading resin, scrap brass, syrup, hides and five Japanese passengers, including Arata Yamamoto and reportedly Katuya Sato.

subfiles.title: Naruto Maru departure report to Navy
subfiles.about: Relays cargo and passenger details.
subfiles.summary: Paraphrases Schraud’s report on Naruto Maru’s Yokohama sailing.

subfiles.title: Kimikawa Maru at Guayaquil
subfiles.about: Reports arrival from Costa Rica and sailing for Callao.
subfiles.summary: Kimikawa Maru arrived July 31 from Punta Arenas and sailed August 4.

subfiles.title: Kimikawa Maru report to Navy
subfiles.about: Relays the Guayaquil movement report.
subfiles.summary: Paraphrases the arrival and Callao sailing.

subfiles.title: Akagi Maru at Buenaventura
subfiles.about: Reports arrival and onward sailing.
subfiles.summary: Akagi Maru arrived August 4 via San Francisco and departed for Peru and Chile.

subfiles.title: Akagi Maru report to Navy
subfiles.about: Relays the Buenaventura call.
subfiles.summary: Paraphrases Williams’s Akagi Maru report.

subfiles.title: Yamazuki Maru at Santos
subfiles.about: Reports arrival from Cristóbal and departure for Kobe.
subfiles.summary: Yamazuki Maru arrived August 5 and sailed August 6 by an unknown route.

subfiles.title: Yamazuki Maru report to Navy
subfiles.about: Relays the Santos movement report.
subfiles.summary: Paraphrases Parsloe’s Yamazuki Maru telegram.

subfiles.title: Yamagiku movements in New Zealand
subfiles.about: Reports departure from Auckland and expected arrival.
subfiles.summary: Yamagiku left Auckland August 4 and was due at Wellington August 8.

subfiles.title: Yamagiku report to Navy
subfiles.about: Forwards Cox’s vessel report.
subfiles.summary: Repeats the Auckland departure and Wellington arrival forecast.

subfiles.title: Heiyo Maru at Buenaventura
subfiles.about: Reports arrival and planned South American route.
subfiles.summary: Heiyo Maru arrived August 7 from Punta Arenas, Costa Rica, and was expected to depart August 8.

subfiles.title: Heiyo Maru report to Navy
subfiles.about: Relays the Buenaventura arrival and onward route.
subfiles.summary: Paraphrases Williams’s report on Heiyo Maru.

subfiles.title: Sakito Maru payment and departure
subfiles.about: Reports a payment to Pemex and sailing for Mollendo.
subfiles.summary: Sakito Maru left August 6 without more fuel after paying about 47,000 pesos to Pemex’s local agent.

subfiles.title: Sakito Maru report to Navy
subfiles.about: Relays the Mollendo departure and cash payment.
subfiles.summary: Paraphrases Schraud’s report on Sakito Maru and Pemex.

subfiles.title: Rakuyo Maru carries Ernst Wendler
subfiles.about: Reports departure for Japan with the former German minister.
subfiles.summary: Rakuyo Maru sailed with Ernst Wendler and family via northern Chilean and Peruvian ports.

subfiles.title: Rakuyo Maru report to Navy
subfiles.about: Relays the Wendler passenger and route report.
subfiles.summary: The damaged copy paraphrases Bowers’s Rakuyo Maru telegram.

subfiles.title: Uncertain Japanese ship at Callao
subfiles.about: Reports a vessel’s arrival and departure.
subfiles.summary: The OCR obscures the ship name; it arrived August 6 from Kobe via Guayaquil and sailed August 8 via Pisco for Valparaíso.

subfiles.title: Rakuyo Maru itinerary and fuel
subfiles.about: Reports the ship’s planned calls and possible fuel loading.
subfiles.summary: Rakuyo Maru sailed August 8, reportedly calling at Los Vilos, Caldera, Iquique, Pisco and Zorritos, where it might take Peruvian government fuel oil.

subfiles.title: Rakuyo Maru itinerary report to Navy
subfiles.about: Relays the itinerary, passengers and fuel report.
subfiles.summary: Paraphrases Burt’s report, adding that Ernst Wendler’s wife and daughter were aboard.
